'''Jara Doweel''' is the woman who owned the farm to which [[Toveine Gazal]] was exiled. 

== Activities ==
She seems to have been a harsh taskmistress, and shared in the labors that she set Toveine to. Toveine remembers that Mistress Doweel would not allow her to console herself with "pretty boys," and also that she taught Mistress Doweel a lesson when Toveine was called back from her exile. The lesson seems to have been poverty, and working for someone harsher than herself.
